tables.label: Members
tables.sentence: Everyone with a Jubilee account: shoppers, renters and the people behind each listing.

tables.label: Staff
tables.sentence: People who can sign in to this admin, and what they are allowed to change.

tables.label: Sessions
tables.sentence: Signed-in devices. Revoking one signs that device out on its next request.

tables.label: Sign-in failures
tables.sentence: Failed sign-in attempts, kept 90 days. Five in ten minutes locks the email.

tables.label: Link tokens
tables.sentence: One-time sign-in and email-verification links. Each works once and lasts 15 minutes.

tables.label: Password reset requests
tables.sentence: Requests to reset a password, with whether the link was used.

tables.label: Security alerts
tables.sentence: Things that look wrong: brute force, impossible travel, many accounts from one device.

tables.label: Consent records
tables.sentence: What each member agreed to, and when. Kept for CASL and PIPEDA, never edited, only superseded.

tables.label: Statement agreements
tables.sentence: Members who agreed to the Jubilee statement of faith and community standards.

tables.label: Data exports
tables.sentence: Member requests for a copy of their data. PIPEDA gives us 30 days.

tables.label: Listings
tables.sentence: Every shop, service and space on Jubilee. Unpublishing hides it from Browse immediately.

tables.label: Listing drafts
tables.sentence: Listings started but never submitted. Autosaved every 10 seconds while the seller types.

tables.label: Listing submissions
tables.sentence: Listings sent for review. Approve publishes; reject returns it to the seller with your note.

tables.label: Listing slugs
tables.sentence: Public URLs for listings. Old slugs redirect to the current one.

tables.label: Listing photos
tables.sentence: Cover and gallery photos on listings. Each is scanned for faces of children and street numbers.

tables.label: Listing views
tables.sentence: Page views on listings, one row per visit. Rolled up nightly into response stats.

tables.label: Products
tables.sentence: Things shops sell. Price and stock are what Browse and the listing page show.

tables.label: Product photos
tables.sentence: Photos on products, in display order.

tables.label: Services
tables.sentence: Bookable offerings on service listings, with how they are priced.

tables.label: Delivery methods
tables.sentence: How a shop gets things to buyers: pickup, local delivery or shipping.

tables.label: Stock alerts
tables.sentence: Members waiting for a product to come back. Sent once when stock goes above zero.

tables.label: Featured slots
tables.sentence: Places on Browse and Home where a listing is promoted, by date range.

tables.label: Response time stats
tables.sentence: How fast each listing answers requests, over the last 30 days. Recomputed nightly.

tables.label: Requests
tables.sentence: Orders, bookings and rental enquiries from members to listings.

tables.label: Request transitions
tables.sentence: Each status change on a request, who made it and why.

tables.label: Conversations
tables.sentence: Message threads between a member and a listing, opened by a request or a question.

tables.label: Messages
tables.sentence: Individual messages. Open only with a reason: staff reads are written to the audit log.

tables.label: Message attachments
tables.sentence: Files sent in messages. Scanned for malware before the recipient can open them.

tables.label: Reviews
tables.sentence: Star ratings and written reviews on listings. Hiding one removes it from the rating too.

tables.label: Listing reports
tables.sentence: Listings that members have reported. One report groups every entry about the same listing.

tables.label: Listing report entries
tables.sentence: Each member’s individual report, with their words.

tables.label: Review reports
tables.sentence: Reviews flagged by sellers or members as unfair, abusive or fake.

tables.label: Conversation reports
tables.sentence: Members reporting a message thread for harassment, spam or off-platform payment.

tables.label: Report actions
tables.sentence: What moderators did about a report, and the note left for the member.

tables.label: Saved items
tables.sentence: Listings and products members have saved for later.

tables.label: Recent searches
tables.sentence: What members typed into search, kept 30 days to power suggestions.

tables.label: Notifications
tables.sentence: In-app, email and push notifications sent to members.

tables.label: Feedback
tables.sentence: Ratings, bug reports and kudos sent from the app’s feedback button.

tables.label: Feedback screenshots
tables.sentence: Screenshots attached to feedback, with the page they were taken on.

tables.label: Merch products
tables.sentence: Jubilee’s own merch: tees, mugs and stickers sold on the marketing site.

tables.label: Merch variants
tables.sentence: Size and colourway combinations, each with its own stock.

tables.label: Merch orders
tables.sentence: Orders from the merch store, paid through Stripe.

tables.label: Merch order lines
tables.sentence: Each variant and quantity on a merch order.

tables.label: Launch subscribers
tables.sentence: Emails collected before launch who want to hear when Jubilee opens in their area.

tables.label: Business pre-registrations
tables.sentence: Businesses who signed up to list before launch, waiting for an invite.

tables.label: Access requests
tables.sentence: People asking to join during invite-only beta. Approving sends a sign-up link.

tables.label: Content versions
tables.sentence: Published copy for site pages and emails. Restoring a version publishes it again.

tables.label: Maintenance windows
tables.sentence: Planned downtime. Members see a banner 24 hours before it starts.

tables.label: Audit records
tables.sentence: Every change made in this admin and every staff read of private data. Cannot be edited.

tables.label: Outbox messages
tables.sentence: Events waiting to be delivered to email, push and webhooks. Retried with backoff.

tables.label: Job runs
tables.sentence: Scheduled and background jobs: what ran, how long it took, and whether it failed.
